$description: Component-specific values that would otherwise be hard-coded in three places. Everything here is a decision from docs/05-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §3, not a convenience alias — and everything here is referenced. On 2026-09-11 this file emitted nine variables and nothing read any of them; each had a hard-coded twin in a component. Row `comfortable` (no density toggle exists) and `cover.size` (an needs the literal in `width`, `height` and `sizes`, so a variable there would be a fourth copy rather than a source) were removed rather than kept as promises.

chip.$description: Signal chips: background at 12 % of the signal colour, border at 40 % (app/utils/signals.ts). min-target is the WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 floor, applied by `.fid-action`.

row.$description: The compact match row (MatchRow.vue): a table of records, 34 px a line.

motion.$description: 150–250 ms for UI feedback, 300–400 ms for layout changes. Movement serves orientation and causality, never decoration. Used by main.css and by every progress bar.
